coverage_notes: Supplementary recall watch only, not primary nationwide collection; production Food Line collector remains authoritative.
Twelve targeted searches (eight fast, four slow) yielded no sufficiently verified, newly reported in-window qualifying U.S. access disruption; findings [] does not prove none occurred.

One social-source verification attempt failed: a Facebook post search snippet said 'Due to the flood threat, we are canceling the food pantry tomorrow at the community center,' but the direct post fetch was throttled. Its post date, U.S. location, provider identity, and relevance to this hour cannot be established. Excluded rather than promoted; this source-specific gap causes DEGRADED status. Source: https://www.facebook.com/61582238523158/posts/pumpkin-bread-class-is-canceled-due-to-the-flooding-we-are-praying-for-everyone-/122127925533074617/

October 25 Guardian report about a Michigan food-assistance helpline temporary suspension for call-volume pressure was published before this window and concerns a helpline rather than immediate SNAP/WIC issuance loss; excluded as preexisting and out of defined window. https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/25/trump-food-stamp-cuts

NY food-bank funding grant story dated October 26 is ordinary program expansion; previously identified and excluded. https://www.timesunion.com/news/article/hochul-food-banks-funding-snap-22493570.php

October 21 report of Kenosha Food Bank planned end-of-2026 closure is prior-window and not an abrupt newly announced same-hour shutdown. https://www.the-sun.com/money/17182682/kenosha-food-bank-wisconsin-closing/

October 24 Wheatsville Co-op article reports closure of one of two co-op locations in Austin, not sole/full-service community grocery loss; the report precedes window. https://www.the-sun.com/money/17199451/grocery-store-shuts-doors/

Search engines largely surfaced older grocery fires, older hurricane cancellations, historical shutdown-related SNAP notices, and general SNAP caseload reporting; none met in-window official immediate access interruption criteria. Search indexing can lag same-hour local notices.
No approval, publication, production collector changes, schedule changes, or task disabling occurred.
